data.narrative:
Bedrock Ocean is a Series A–stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by Anthony DiMare and Charles Chiau. The company has raised $63M to date. The comparable universe for this sector remains nascent, with only two identifiable private peers (Seasats and Havoc AI) and no direct public comparables, reflecting the frontier nature of ocean tech as an investment category.

Stage-progression valuation was the applicable methodology given data constraints. Using total raised ($63M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $126M. This reflects the conventional expectation that companies graduating from Series A achieve a meaningful revenue or product milestone justifying capital appreciation before Series B fundraising.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $107M (low) to $145M (median $126M), anchored to the single applicable method. The width of this range—approximately $38M or ±15% of the median—captures reasonable variance around Series A-stage progression assumptions. Key uncertainties include the composition and growth trajectory of Bedrock Ocean's revenue base relative to its peer set, the company's cash runway and burn profile relative to the $63M deployed, and broader demand signals in ocean technology markets. With only one valuation method applicable and a minimal comparable set, this range should be treated as preliminary pending deeper operational diligence.
